identity.title: SPT0346-52: Negligible AGN Activity in a Compact, Hyper-starburst Galaxy at z = 5.7

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present *Chandra* ACIS-S and ATCA radio continuum observations of the strongly lensed dusty, star-forming galaxy SPT-S J034640-5204.9 (hereafter SPT0346-52) at $z$ = 5.656.

question.value: Does an AGN contribute appreciably to the IR luminosity and the extreme SFR surface density of SPT0346-52?

evidence.quote: The central question is whether this high luminosity surface density arises solely from intense star formation, or if there is an obscured active galactic nucleus (AGN).
